title: Native SQLite transactional user-data vault foundation
summary: P01-T07 Rust-only native SQLite WAL commit/reopen, bounded data ownership, SQLite online backup, disposable restore drill; no frontend or production data writes. Native startup OS-root integration, SQLite sidecar validation and no-overwrite disposable restore are pending new Windows CI. Old static contract initially rejected authorized native-only setup; corrected the test to fail if vault is exposed in IPC, not in trusted native startup. Native P01-T07 core accepted on real Windows boot: WAL SQLite file outside executable, integrity/schema, new-only commits, online backup and disposable restore tests. Full M23 product/release remains incomplete.
migration_notes: New schema v1; no previous native user vault. Unexpected existing schema is refused without migration; do not delete or overwrite any user data.
